text: I will remember my song in the night; I will meditate with my heart, And my spirit searches:
And I said, "This is my grief, That the right hand of the Most High has changed [and His lovingkindness is withheld]."
You have with Your [great] arm redeemed Your people, The sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.
You led Your people like a flock By the hand of Moses and Aaron [to the promised goal].
